mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itinerary_node (day_id, place_id, place_name, node_type, seq, start_time, end_time, cost) VALUES (#{dayId}, #{placeId}, #{placeName}, #{nodeType}, #{seq}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{cost})
mapper.select: SELECT n.* FROM itinerary_node n JOIN itinerary_day d ON n.day_id = d.id WHERE d.itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} ORDER BY d.day_index, n.seq
